title: Castlefield Charge
summary: Supplier profile and banking disbursement record for Castlefield Charge under payment run PR-20261022.
body:
Castlefield Charge is a payee receiving disbursements from Northbridge Cycles' accounts payable payment runs [^r1]. Under payment run PR-20261022, processed via [[sop-ap-003|SOP-AP-003 Supplier Payment Run]], the supplier received a settlement of £220,992.00 [^r1]. Its settlement details are recorded in the payment export file [[data-bank-file-sample-2026-10-22|Bank File Sample 2026-10-22 (PR-20261022)]] [^r1].

## Record
Castlefield Charge holds bank account number 90012877 under sort code 40-22-14 [^r1]. On 22 October 2026, payment run PR-20261022 remitted £220,992.00 to this account [^r1].
